title: 某团队发表传统藏药‘Tale’的植物来源及化学成分研究
originalTitle: Molecular and phytochemical investigation of medicinal Rhododendron spp. in the Qinghai-Xizang Plateau: the botanical sources of the traditional Tibetan medicine "Tale"
summary: 某团队对青藏高原的46份Rhododendron标本进行分子鉴定和HPLC定量分析，发现‘Talegabao’物种黄酮类化合物总量超过‘Talenabao’，并验证psbA-trnH区域可用于区分两者，为传统藏药质量控制提供依据。
